quest_details.objective: Kill Edwin VanCleef and bring his head to Gryan Stoutmantle.
Bring Foreman Thistlenettle's Explorers' League Badge to Wilder Thistlenettle in Stormwind.
Retrieve 4 Miners' Union Cards and return them to Wilder Thistlenettle in Stormwind.
Scout Riell at the Sentinel Hill Tower wants you to bring her 10 Red Silk Bandanas.
Councilman Millstipe of Darkshire wants you to bring him the hand of Dextren Ward.
Motley Garmason wants Kam Deepfury's head brought to him at Dun Modr.
Bring the head of Targorr the Dread to Guard Berton in Lakeshire.
Warden Thelwater of Stormwind wants you to kill 10 Defias Prisoners, 8 Defias Convicts, and 8 Defias Insurgents in The Stockade.
Nikova Raskol of Stormwind wants you to collect 10 Red Wool Bandanas.
Kill Bazil Thredd and bring his head back to Warden Thelwater at the Stockade.
Bring the Gems of Cobrahn, Anacondra, Pythas and Serpentis to Nara Wildmane in Thunder Bluff.
Crane Operator Bigglefuzz in Ratchet wants you to retrieve the bottle of 99-Year-Old Port from Mad Magglish who is hiding in the Wailing Caverns.
Apothecary Zamah in Thunder Bluff wants you to collect 10 Serpentbloom.
Bring the Lorgalis Manuscript to Gerrig Bonegrip in the Forlorn Cavern in Ironforge.
Bring the Book of Ur to Keeper Bel'dugur at the Apothecarium in the Undercity.
Kill Arugal and bring his head to Dalar Dawnweaver at the Sepulcher.
Kill High Inquisitor Whitemane, Scarlet Commander Mograine, Herod, the Scarlet Champion and Houndmaster Loksey and then report back to Varimathras in the Undercity.
Retrieve the Compendium of the Fallen from the Monastery in Tirisfal Glades and return to Sage Truthseeker in Thunder Bluff.
Retrieve Mythology of the Titans from the Monastery and bring it to Librarian Mae Paledust in Ironforge.
Return Vorrel Sengutz's wedding ring to Monika Sengutz in Tarren Mill.
Kill High Inquisitor Whitemane, Scarlet Commander Mograine,  Herod, the Scarlet Champion and Houndmaster Loksey and then report back to Raleigh the Devout in Southshore.
Find the Deathstalker Adamant and Deathstalker Vincent.
Master Apothecary Faranell in the Undercity wants 20 Hearts of Zeal.
Seek out Argent Guard Thaelrid in Blackfathom Deeps.
Bring 10 Twilight Pendants to Argent Guard Manados in Darnassus.
Bring the head of Twilight Lord Kelris to Dawnwatcher Selgorm in Darnassus.
Gershala Nightwhisper in Auberdine wants 8 Corrupt Brain stems.

Find the Gauntlet of Gordok Might and return it to Captain Kromcrush in Dire Maul.$B$BAccording to Kromcrush, the "old timey story" says that Tortheldrin - a "creepy" elf who called himself a prince - stole it from one of the Gordok kings.
Collect 20 Fetishes of Hakkar and bring them to Fel'Zerul in Stonard.
The Atal'ai Exile in The Hinterlands wants the Head of Jammal'an.
Gather 10 Atal'ai Tablets for Brohann Caskbelly in Stormwind.
Nalpak in the Wailing Caverns wants 20 Deviate Hides.
Ebru in the Wailing Caverns wants you to kill 7 Deviate Ravagers, 7 Deviate Vipers, 7 Deviate Shamblers and 7 Deviate Dreadfangs.
Speak with Hamuul Runetotem.
Speak with Nara Wildmane.
Bring 6 portions of Wailing Essence to Mebok Mizzyrix in Ratchet.
Retrieve the Gnoam Sprecklesprocket from the Deadmines and return it to Shoni the Shilent in Stormwind.
Andrew Brownell wants you to kill Amnennar the Coldbringer and return his skull.
Travel to Ratchet to find the meaning behind the Nightmare Shard.
Place the Essence of Eranikus in the Essence Font located in this lair in the Sunken Temple.
Find Marvon Rivetseeker in Tanaris.
Find the Altar of Hakkar in the Sunken Temple in Swamp of Sorrows.
Travel into the Sunken Temple and discover the secret hidden in the circle of statues.
If you agree to aid Belnistrasz, speak with him again and hand the Oathstone he gave you back to him.
Escort Belnistrasz to the Quilboar's idol in Razorfen Downs.$B$BProtect Belnistrasz while he performs the ritual to shut down the idol.
Bring the Filled Egg of Hakkar to Yeh'kinya in Tanaris.
Archbishop Bendictus wants you to slay Amnennar the Coldbringer in Razorfen Downs.
Deliver the Unloaded Zapper and 5 samples of Atal'ai Haze to Larion in Marshal's Refuge.
Place Dawn's Gambit in the Viewing Room of the Scholomance.  Defeat Vectus, then return to Betina Bigglezink.
Recover 10 Plagued Flesh Samples from Stratholme and return them to Betina Bigglezink. You suspect that any creature in Stratholme would have said flesh sample.
Travel to Stratholme and search the ziggurats. Find and return new Scourge Data to Betina Bigglezink.$B
Find Fras Siabi's smoke shop in Stratholme and recover a box of Siabi's Premium Tobacco. Return to Smokey LaRue when the job is done.$B

Travel to Stratholme, in the north. Search the supply crates that litter the city and recover 5 Stratholme Holy Water. Return to Leonid Barthalomew the Revered when you have collected enough of the blessed fluid.
Travel to Stratholme and find Archivist Galford of the Scarlet Crusade. Destroy him and burn down the Scarlet Archive.
Take the Head of Balnazzar to Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff in the Eastern Plaguelands.
Venture to Stratholme and destroy Baron Rivendare. Take his head and return to Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff.$B

Use Egan's Blaster on the ghostly and spectral citizens of Stratholme. When the restless souls break free from their ghostly shells, use the blaster again - freedom will be theirs!$B$BFree 15 Restless Souls and return to Egan.

Venture to the Scholomance and recover the Barov family fortune. Four deeds make up this fortune: The Deed to Caer Darrow; The Deed to Brill; The Deed to Tarren Mill; and The Deed to Southshore. Return to Alexi Barov when you have completed this task.

Venture to the Scholomance and recover the Barov family fortune. Four deeds make up this fortune: The Deed to Caer Darrow; The Deed to Brill; The Deed to Tarren Mill; and The Deed to Southshore. Return to Weldon Barov when you have completed this task.
Find Doctor Theolen Krastinov inside the Scholomance. Destroy him, then burn the Remains of Eva Sarkhoff and the Remains of Lucien Sarkhoff. Return to Eva Sarkhoff when the task is complete.$B
Take the Bag of Horrors to Eva Sarkhoff on Caer Darrow.

Return to the Scholomance with the Blood of Innocents. Find the porch and place the Blood of Innocents in the brazier. Kirtonos will come to feast upon your soul.$B$BFight valiantly, do not give an inch! Destroy Kirtonos and return to Eva Sarkhoff.$B
Travel to Stratholme and find Menethil's Gift. Place the Keepsake of Remembrance upon the unholy ground.

Find Ras Frostwhisper in the Scholomance. When you have found him, use the Soulbound Keepsake on his undead visage. Should you succeed in reverting him to a mortal, strike him down and recover the Human Head of Ras Frostwhisper. Take the head back to Magistrate Marduke.
Locate Jandice Barov in the Scholomance and destroy her. From her corpse recover Krastinov's Bag of Horrors. Return the bag to Eva Sarkhoff.
Bring 4 Bolts of Runecloth, 8 Rugged Leather, 2 Rune Threads, and Ogre Tannin to Knot Thimblejack.  He is currently chained inside the Gordok wing of Dire Maul.
Kill 20 Plagued Hatchlings, then return to Betina Bigglezink at the Light's Hope Chapel.
Bring the Frozen Eggs to Betina Bigglezink.
Bring the Healthy Dragon Scale to Betina Bigglezink at the Light's Hope Chapel in Eastern Plaguelands.
Search Ragefire Chasm for Maur Grimtotem's corpse and search it for any items of interest.
Search Orgrimmar for Ragefire Chasm, then kill 8 Ragefire Troggs and 8 Ragefire Shaman before returning to Rahauro in Thunder Bluff.
Take the Grimtotem Satchel to Rahauro in Thunder Bluff.
Bring the books Spells of Shadow and Incantations from the Nether to Varimathras in Undercity.
Kill Bazzalan and Jergosh the Invoker before returning to Thrall in Orgrimmar.
Enter Ragefire Chasm and slay Taragaman the Hungerer, then bring his heart back to Neeru Fireblade in Orgrimmar.

Travel to Stratholme, in the northern part of the Plaguelands. It is in the Scarlet Bastion that you will find the painting 'Of Love and Family,' hidden behind another painting depicting the twin moons of our world.$B$BReturn the painting to Tirion Fordring.
Travel to Stratholme and slay Ramstein the Gorger. Take his head as a souvenir for Nathanos.
Bring Ambassador Malcin's Head to Bragor Bloodfist in the Undercity.
Take the Small Scroll to Bragor Bloodfist at the Royal Quarter in the Undercity.
Bring the head of Twilight Lord Kelris to Bashana Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.
Speak to Je'neu Sancrea in Ashenvale.
Bring 20 Sapphires of Aku'Mai to Je'neu Sancrea in Ashenvale.
Bring the Damp Note to Je'neu Sancrea at Zoram'gar Outpost in Ashenvale.
Kill Lorgus Jett in Blackfathom Deeps and then return to Je'neu Sancrea in Ashenvale.
Kill 8 Razorfen Battleguard, 8 Razorfen Thornweavers, and 8 Death's Head Cultists and return to Myriam Moonsinger near the entrance to Razorfen Downs.
Bring the Fathom Core to Je'neu Sancrea at Zoram'gar Outpost, Ashenvale.
Travel to Ratchet to find someone that can tell you more about the glowing shard.$B$BThen, deliver the shard as you are directed.
Collect 15 Theradric Crystal Carvings for Willow in Desolace.

Fill the Coated Cerulean Vial at the orange crystal pool in Maraudon.$B$BUse the Filled Cerulean Vial on the Vylestem Vines to force the corrupted Noxxious Scion to emerge.$B$BHeal 8 plants by killing these Noxxious Scion, then return to Vark Battlescar in Shadowprey Village.

Fill the Coated Cerulean Vial at the orange crystal pool in Maraudon.$B$BUse the Filled Cerulean Vial on the Vylestem Vines to force the corrupted Noxxious Scion to emerge.$B$BHeal 8 plants by killing these Noxxious Scion, then return to Talendria in Nijel's Point.
Recover the two parts of the Scepter of Celebras: the Celebrian Rod and the Celebrian Diamond.$B$BFind a way to speak with Celebras.
Assist Celebras the Redeemed while he creates the Scepter of Celebras.$B$BSpeak with him when the ritual is complete.
Slay Princess Theradras and return to Selendra near Shadowprey Village in Desolace.
Slay Princess Theradras and return to Keeper Marandis at Nijel's Point in Desolace.
Seek out Remulos in Moonglade and give him the Seed of Life.
Read the Pariah's Instructions. Afterwards, obtain the Amulet of Union from Maraudon and return it to the Centaur Pariah in southern Desolace.
Collect 10 Shadowshard Fragments from Maraudon and return them to Uthel'nay in Orgrimmar.
Collect 10 Shadowshard Fragments from Maraudon and return them to Archmage Tervosh in Theramore on the coast of Dustwallow Marsh.

Travel to Dire Maul and locate the Imp, Pusillin. Convince Pusillin to give you Azj'Tordin's Book of Incantations through any means necessary.$B$BReturn to Azj'Tordin at the Lariss Pavilion in Feralas should you recover the Book of Incantations.

You must destroy the guardians surrounding the 5 Pylons that power the Prison of Immol'thar. Once the Pylons have powered down, the force field surrounding Immol'thar will have dissipated.$B$BEnter the Prison of Immol'thar and eradicate the foul demon that stands at its heart. Finally, confront Prince Tortheldrin in Athenaeum.$B$BReturn to the Shen'dralar Ancient in the courtyard should you complete this quest.
Return to the Athenaeum and find the Treasure of the Shen'dralar. Claim your reward!
Travel to the Warpwood Quarter of Dire Maul and slay the water elemental, Hydrospawn. Return to Lorekeeper Lydros in the Athenaeum with the Hydrospawn Essence.
Search Dire Maul for Kariel Winthalus. Report back to Sage Korolusk at Camp Mojache with whatever information that you may find.
Search Dire Maul for Kariel Winthalus. Report back to Scholar Runethorn at Feathermoon with whatever information that you may find.
Bring a Libram of Rapidity, 1 Pristine Black Diamond, 2 Large Brilliant Shards, and 2 Blood of Heroes to Lorekeeper Lydros in Dire Maul to receive an Arcanum of Rapidity.

Venture to the Molten Core entry portal in Blackrock Depths and recover a Core Fragment. Return to Lothos Riftwaker in Blackrock Mountain when you have recovered the Core Fragment.
